x: Memories of Brighton Walks with Tommy Green, Fred Rickards and Fred Bentley to the fore, followed by many other stalwarts; of National 20-Miles Championships with George Cooper, Bob McMullen (Senior), Stanley Manning. Jack Rathbone. Joe King, Jack Bidgood and others, striving their utmost.

Jack Rathbone, one of our long-distance walking stalwarts of some dozen or so years ago, sends greetings to his old friends and invites any of them to call on him for a cup of tea and a yarn if they are down Herne Bay way, where he now has a place of his own.
After 25 years we are going stronger than ever. We won the team race and gained 1st and 3rd places in the open handicap with J.
1923 · J. Miles · 8 · 53 · 39 · J. Bellchamber · J. Rathbone

Alf Harley recently met Jack Rathbone, one of our old Police walking members, who will be kindly remembered by many of the older members. Jack is still his old cheery self and wishes to be remembered to all his old Clubmates.
